wrong_pool.title: Your payment reached us
wrong_pool.body: We received your payment, but it went to a different pool than your assigned one. We can't move it across automatically. Tap 'Get help' and our helpdesk will sort it out with you.
amount_mismatch.title: Your payment reached us
amount_mismatch.body: We received your payment, but the amount didn't match this cycle's fixed contribution. We can't adjust it automatically. Tap 'Get help' and our helpdesk will sort it out with you.
active_contribution.title: My Pool
active_contribution.tone.calm: Your pool is open — contribute when you can
active_contribution.tone.calm_a11y: Your pool is open. You can contribute when you are ready.
active_contribution.tone.closing: Last day — please contribute to support {family}'s family
active_contribution.tone.closing_a11y: This is the last day. Please contribute to support {family}'s family.
